biotools.summary: gllvm is an R package for analyzing multivariate ecological data using Generalized Linear Latent Variable Models (GLLVMs). It offers fast fitting of advanced ordination methods and joint species distribution models, incorporating features like phylogenetic random effects and enhanced inference capabilities.
